user.title: Connect a Koyoe KY-EST20KH
user.description: Select the USB Serial Port exposed by the Connect AUX-2 that is wired to your KY-EST20KH. The integration reads Modbus RTU using address 247 and 9600 baud (8N1). Close other readers on this bus before continuing.

error.cannot_connect: No valid readings. Check the selected port, adapter, wiring and Modbus address. Close any other reader using the bus.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already configured.
